thread:
Anya: quick heads-up — xenon-v2 int8 canary is emitting mixed-script numeric outputs, looks like CJK/latin token aliasing, repro below
Kevin: can you paste a tiny repro and the exact outputs?
Anya: sure. prompt: "Translate to zh-TW: 2024年のQ1 revenue was $5.2M"
Anya: int8 (canary) output: "2024年のQ1 收入 是 $5.2M。"  — note Japanese 'の' + zh phrasing
Anya: fp16 baseline: "2024 年第 一 季 營收 為 520 萬 美元。"
Sophia: how bad on metrics (chrF/BLEU/embeds)?
Anya: chrF shortctx numeric-heavy set: fp16 9.2 -> int8 6.1
Anya: embedding cosine sim (fp16 vs int8) for same prompt: 0.83 -> 0.66
EvalBot: automated-eval run 1766543000 flagged regression: locales=[zh-TW, ja-zh-mixed], severity=high
Liao: sounds like token id aliasing / remap problem after embedding packer reorder in quant artifact
Kevin: tokenizer vs runtime? do detok/token id compare between CPU tokenizer and runtime-emitted ids
Anya: did that. token id sequences differ at positions 6..8 on many samples. example:
Anya: fp16 ids: [1023, 45012, 678, 10, 200]
Anya: int8 ids: [1023, 45012, 342, 10, 200]
Anya: 678 -> 342 swap correlates with ZWJ/combining-grapheme cases
Anya: tokdump pasted below:
```
# sample: "2024年のQ1 revenue"
cpu_token_ids: 1023, 45012, 678, 9001
runtime_token_ids: 1023, 45012, 342, 9001\```
Sophia: check artifact for a permute/packer map (packer_map.bin / permute_map.bin). if embedded table was packed with a reordering, loader must apply remap at tokenization stage
Anya: found packer_map.bin in artifact root — checksum mismatch vs q8 build output
Kevin: build detail? packer used 32-bit offsets anywhere? truncation for vocab > 65536 would explain wrong indices
Anya: our_vocab ~75k, so >65536 yes
Liao: that matches. packer sometimes emits 32-bit indices for alignment optimization; packer_map gets truncated when writing if codepath compiled w/ 32-bit offset default
Sophia: action plan: (1) repro minimal slice with vocab size >65k to confirm truncation; (2) rebuild packer with 64-bit offsets and repack artifact; (3) run smoke eval for chrF + embed sim; (4) add CI unit test for packer_map integrity up to vocab=200k
Anya: I'll run step (1) and attach the minimal tarball if it repros
Kevin: also add a small nightly regression that includes mixed-script numerals and ZWJ combos — these hit production usecases
Anya: rolling back canary for any routes serving zh-TW numerics until we confirm fix
OpsBot: deploy rollback initiated for xenon-v2:int8 canary (job 4721)
Liao: will draft small patch to packer to force 64-bit offsets and add assertions
Sophia: add a short eval test in the onboarding harness for xenon-v2 int8 before next canary
Anya: I have ~120 detok samples showing consistent 678->342 swap, will upload to /artifacts/xenon_int8_tokdumps/
Kevin: thanks — will debug packer_map checksum mismatch after lunch :coffee:
Anya: thx all :thumbsup:
